methodology.oracle: Fixed declared leaf names, credited only for actual onclick HTTP events retained across browser restarts. Attempts, completion and empty queues are separately checked claims.
methodology.providers: Deterministic fixture decision providers; request counts are orchestration counts, not live-model quality or latency.
methodology.scope: Independent local fixtures only; one browser at a time; no existing service, browser, or task database.
methodology.unknownFault: After the SDK performs a real browser recovery, its owned temporary attempt record is changed to unknown to simulate a durable-result fault; original status must remain unknown.
methodology.unavailableFault: Before restart only, recovery calls return UNVERIFIED without dispatching any browser action. After restart the fault is removed.
methodology.timeLimits: 60 second task duration and 75 second outer phase timeout; observe timeout 1000ms; settle 0ms.
methodology.retryMetric: A failed recovery repeated under the same normalized visible-control conditions without new oracle coverage; phase and generated observation/document IDs do not reset this metric.
methodology.limits: Small controlled fixtures with explicit safe-repeat contracts. Results cannot establish real-site exhaustion, arbitrary browser snapshot restoration, or live-model efficiency.

evidence: One operation sample per encountered control, target constraints, option and declared context
Target-region operation reference only; active boundaries and dispatch permission are checked separately
All captured selector states, including cross-form, cross-region and hidden modes; structure does not prove independence
Passive text and free-text starting values excluded; selector values and semantic bindings retained
Observed source-condition samples only; unobserved JavaScript state, free-text dependencies and all combinations are not covered

explorationAudit.limitation: Complete only means all recorded cases have successful execution, equivalent operation-sample evidence, or explicit scope exclusion/retirement. Equivalent cases were not dispatched again; exclusions are not coverage. Undiscovered controls, value combinations, business assertions and adapter discovery gaps require separate verification.
